_comment: The trackability shots stand them IN THE HUB rather than on the
bench's grey slab, because `enemy_projectile`'s constraint is 'must be
trackable against six theme backgrounds' and a prop photographed
against a flat backdrop answers a different question.
Only concrete_facility exists as a built theme, so this is one of six.
The other five are behind the theme-kit gate ART_FRONTIER already
records; saying so beats a sheet that implies the test was done.
